publisher: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives
title_or_table: Statistics of the Presidential and Congressional Election of November 5, 2024 (published March 10, 2025), House races
table_id: Clerk of the House, election statistics 2024
observation_period: General election of November 5, 2024 (Louisiana’s open primary the same day; Maine’s ranked-choice tabulation as the Clerk prints it)
geography: The 435 House districts of the 50 states
universe_or_base: Every line the Clerk prints for a House race: candidates, write-ins, and for Maine blank, continuing and exhausted ballots
vintage: Compiled by the Clerk from official sources, published March 10, 2025
qualification: Party labels as the Clerk prints them, which follow each state’s ballot. New York and Connecticut list a candidate’s votes on each party line separately (fusion). A candidate with no vote count printed (some states print none for an unopposed race) has an empty votes cell.

candidate.description: candidate, or the ballot category as printed

party_line.description: party line as printed; a fusion line carries the candidate above it

line_kind.description: candidate, fusion line (New York and Connecticut), write-in or other, or not a vote for a candidate (blank, void, over and under votes, continuing and exhausted ballots)

printed_source_line: Source: Office of the Clerk, U.S. House of Representatives, Statistics of the Presidential and Congressional Election of November 5, 2024, House races, 50 states. Retrieved November 12, 2026. Official results as compiled March 10, 2025.
